notes.title: First Early Access update here!
notes.content:
- RTP removed
- fixed an error that caused the player to start with wrong characters
- added resources to game database
- fixed an error that caused player sprite to be visible when watching memoria scenes
- fixed various pathing
- fixed an error that caused player to be transported to the end of a chapter
